---
title: Redis
description: Redis connections for cache, session, and future queues.
---

`kona-redis` exposes a small `RedisConnection` API backed by an in-memory client (default) or Lettuce.

## Config

```
redis.default=default
redis.client=memory   # or lettuce
redis.connections.default.host=127.0.0.1
redis.connections.default.port=6379
# or redis.connections.default.url=redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0
```

## Usage

```kotlin
val redis = RedisManager(config).connection()
redis.set("key", "value")
redis.setex("ttl", 60, "value")
redis.get("key")
```

Register `RedisServiceProvider` to bind `RedisManager` and the default `RedisConnection`.

## Session driver

Set `session.driver=redis` and pass a `RedisConnection` into `SessionManager` (or resolve both from the container). Keys use `session.connection_prefix` (default `kona_session:`).
